avoid_supplements.name: High-dose chromium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive glucose-lowering effects may increase hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on hypoglycemia symptoms

avoid_supplements.name: Bitter melon extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates insulin secretion and glucose reduction leading to synergistic hypoglycemic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue bitter melon; monitor blood glucose closely if unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng (American and Asian)
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; educate on hypoglycemia awareness

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Modest glucose-lowering potential with GLP-1 agonists
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia; dose adjustment of dulaglutide may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Fenugreek
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on hypoglycemia recognition; routine glucose monitoring

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (>50g fat)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays gastric emptying and may worsen nausea/GI adverse effects already common with GLP-1 agonists
avoid_foods.action: Advise low-fat, small frequent meals; take dulaglutide with light meals

caution_foods.name: Rapid-acting simple carbohydrates
caution_foods.mechanism: Enhanced glucose-lowering effect may increase hypoglycemia risk
caution_foods.action: Educate on balanced carbohydrate intake; reserve for hypoglycemia treatment

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: Impairs gluconeogenesis and awareness of hypoglycemic symptoms
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol; counsel on hypoglycemia risk and never drink on empty stomach

monitoring_notes: Dulaglutide is a peptide not metabolized by CYP enzymes, limiting drug-drug interactions; however, cumulative glucose-lowering effects remain the primary concern. Monitor for hypoglycemia and GI effects (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea); adjust background diabetes medications as needed and reinforce dietary counseling emphasizing low-fat, balanced meals.
